layout: Single unframed top-left stack, maximum width 300px. Narrow viewport reserves top map padding through the stack's bottom; wide viewport reserves its left edge. Expanded result content scrolls within a bounded stack. About data and attribution remain separate.

attribution.reason: Official OneMap GreyLite integration explicitly instructs not to remove attribution. The logo/copyright line is not an optional map legend.

tests.delta: 240 + 2 top-left viewport tests = 242 tests; 32 existing test files + 0 new files = 32. Updated shell assertion reflects new owner layout.

browser.mode: Installed headless Chrome, SwiftShader, local production build, actual local data/OneMap tiles, service worker enabled. Viewport emulation, not a real phone.

Layout and route checks passed; three route screenshots preceded full basemap source readiness. Peripheral blur is preserved, not presented as full tile-load acceptance.
Chrome debugging endpoint did not become available within 90 seconds; no application test ran. No hardware-only cause established.
Bounded browser startup with stderr recorded; captures wait for both route and basemap readiness. All checks pass.

browser.checks: Brand above left search; accessible in-field submit and Enter; equal-width result below input; bottom-right disclosure clears visible attribution; expanded mobile stack leaves route space; root and shared-postal revisits work under an active service worker.
browser.limits: No representative latency measurement, physical touchscreen keyboard, old-release-to-new cache upgrade or live production validation. Chrome GCM DEPRECATED_ENDPOINT messages are browser background stderr, not reported as application exceptions.

findings: Moving the former bottom sheet requires a different map-padding edge, not just CSS offsets. New top-left overlay logic is covered by tests and current-route captures.
All required sizes render the selected route and fully loaded basemap in final captures. Failed setup/browser attempts and early peripheral-tile captures remain preserved.
The OneMap logo/copyright line must remain while using this basemap; optional About data moves independently.
disagreements: Cannot hide OneMap attribution under its published integration guidance. No disagreement with the requested layout.
